name: Kurgu Ink
tagline: kurgu-atolyesi's vertical grammar: flat ink plates, one blue, mono micro-labels, a graphics band above the head, punch-ins on cuts.

motion.direction: kurgu-atolyesi vertical (V0–V5). Flat ink plates (`stage` / `mar`, line `#2C313B`), text `iv`, muted `goldd`, ONE accent blue `ter`, negative red only for the strike; Inter 800 titles (72 px, tracking −1.2, soft shadow), accent word 124 px, mono micro-labels `// KICKER`, `● 03 CHAPTER` (JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracking 6). Graphics live in the band above the head (y 160–720); one message at a time, each exits before the next; something changes every 1–2 s. Enter 0.38 s sliding 28 px with ease (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), exit 0.22 s; punch-ins 100 ↔ 112–118 % on cuts; cold open 0–6 s with a strike headline and a counting number; a chapter tag + one persistent device (timeline / total / checklist); a source line under every external fact. Text never moves once placed; faces never under graphics.
